label: Continuous Audit Framework Design
description: Designs automated, continuous audit checks for high-risk processes. Defines control monitoring, alert thresholds, reporting cadence, and escalation paths.

claudeKnowledge.description: Continuous auditing frameworks, ISACA, IIA guidance on data analytics in audit

guidedInputs.label: Processes or control areas for continuous monitoring
guidedInputs.description: Which high-risk processes or controls should be monitored continuously?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Transaction monitoring alert management (SLA compliance), access management (privileged access provisioning/deprovisioning), trade reconciliation (T+1 matching rates), customer onboarding (mandatory field completion rates), expenses (policy compliance, dual approval)

guidedInputs.label: Available data sources and systems
guidedInputs.description: What systems, databases, or extracts are available to source the monitoring data?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Core banking system (SQL), TM platform (API/daily export), HR system (Active Directory integration), ERP (SAP data extracts), Excel-based processes (manual reports)

options.label: No continuous monitoring — pure periodic audits
Basic: some ad hoc data analysis during audits
Developing: some automated reports, not fully integrated
Established: continuous monitoring exists, needs enhancement
Mixed: daily for critical, monthly for others

guidedInputs.label: Additional constraints or context (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: IT limitations, data access restrictions, regulatory expectations (ECB/FSA requirements for continuous monitoring), budget constraints, timeline...
